how: Opened the public ChatGPT share page and selected the longest assistant answer (math, code, tables and 57 images) from its first block to its last with a DOM range (what a mouse drag over the answer yields), then ran document.execCommand("copy").
notes:
Selection capture (DOM range + execCommand('copy')), so it is Chrome's serialization: org.chromium.source-url is the page URL, every element carries a computed inline style=, the first block starts with
, and plain text is the rendered text (UI labels such as 'Thought for ...' / 'Worked for ...' can lead it; tokens of rendered math sit on separate lines). Code blocks lose their language-* classes in this path. Long answer (~44,000 characters): 80 KaTeX nodes, 24 
, 3 tables, 216
